definition_en: standing for something else by association, or belonging to a system of signs
core_image: 一面旗子替一整支队伍站在广场中央，旗上没有一个士兵。
scene: 谈判桌上摆着一枚没有实际功能的木槌，双方都明白它代表的是最终决定权。The wooden gavel on the table is symbolic, standing for authority that no one can see.
sceneCN: 这里 symbolic 指「以联想方式代表另一事物的」（第 1 个义项：本身不是那件事物，却因共同承认而代表它）；句意为桌上那枚不能真正敲击的木槌代表看不见的最终决定权。可辨识物件：木槌、长桌、双方代表、空着的椅子。

pos.zh: 象征性的；符号的；仅具象征意义的

senses.title: Standing for something by association
senses.titleCN: 以联想关系代表另一事物
senses.definition: representing something else because a community or a person treats the sign as standing for it
senses.definitionCN: 因群体或个人把某一标记视为代表另一事物，从而具有代表作用
senses.example: The wooden gavel on the table is symbolic, standing for authority that no one can see.
senses.exampleCN: 桌上那枚木槌是象征性的，代表看不见的权威。
senses.why: The adjective names the relation, not the object: the sign is real, but what it points to is not present in it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词命名的是关系而非物体：标记本身真实存在，但它所指的东西并不在标记里面。

senses.title: Belonging to a system of signs
senses.definition: relating to signs that carry meaning by convention, as in symbolic language or symbolic notation
senses.definitionCN: 与按约定承载意义的符号有关，如符号语言或符号记法
senses.example: Chemists use symbolic notation to write reactions in one line.
senses.exampleCN: 化学家用符号记法把反应写成一行。
senses.why: A symbol works only inside a code, so the adjective also describes anything that belongs to such a code.
senses.whyCN: 符号只有在代码内部才起作用，因此这个形容词也描述属于这种代码的任何东西。

senses.title: In name only
senses.titleCN: 只是名义上的；仅有象征意义
senses.definition: having little practical effect and serving mainly to express a position or intention
senses.definitionCN: 几乎没有实际效果，主要用来表达立场或意图
senses.example: The fine was symbolic, but the ruling changed how firms behaved.
senses.exampleCN: 罚款只是象征性的，但裁决改变了企业的做法。
senses.why: When a gesture stands for an intention instead of producing an effect, it is called symbolic in a mildly critical way.
senses.whyCN: 当一个姿态只是代表某种意图、却不产生实际效果时，人们就带点批评地说它是象征性的。

senses.title: Relating to symbolism in art
senses.titleCN: 与艺术中的象征主义有关的
senses.definition: using visible forms to suggest inner states or ideas rather than to depict them directly
senses.definitionCN: 用可见形式暗示内心状态或观念，而不是直接描绘它们
senses.example: The symbolic imagery of the painting avoids any clear narrative.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画的象征意象避开了清晰的叙事。
senses.why: Symbolist artists made the sign carry the feeling, so the adjective became a period label as well as a description.
senses.whyCN: 象征派艺术家让标记承载感受，因此这个形容词既是一般描述，也成为一个时期标签。

senses.title: Manipulating signs rather than numbers
senses.definition: describing computation or logic that operates on formal expressions instead of numeric values
senses.definitionCN: 指对形式表达式而非数值进行操作的运算或逻辑
senses.example: Symbolic computation can solve the equation without approximating it.
senses.exampleCN: 符号运算可以直接解方程，而不必取近似值。
senses.why: Computer science distinguishes work on expressions from work on quantities, and calls the former symbolic.
senses.whyCN: 计算机科学把对表达式的处理与对数量的处理区分开，并把前者称为符号的。

senses.title: Carrying shared public meaning
senses.definition: expressing a value or identity that a group recognizes, such as a flag or a monument
senses.definitionCN: 表达某个群体所承认的价值或身份，如旗帜或纪念碑
senses.example: The bridge became symbolic of the city's recovery.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥成为这座城市复苏的象征。
senses.why: Public signs gather meaning from repeated use, so one object can stand for a whole shared history.
senses.whyCN: 公共标记在反复使用中积累意义，因此一个物件可以代表一整段共同历史。

senses.title: Ritual rather than literal
senses.titleCN: 仪式性的而非字面操作的
senses.definition: performed for its recognized meaning rather than for a practical result
senses.definitionCN: 因其被承认的意义而进行，而非为取得实际结果
senses.example: The first cut was symbolic, and the real work began afterwards.
senses.exampleCN: 第一刀是象征性的，真正的工作随后才开始。
senses.why: Ritual action is all meaning and little consequence, which is exactly the contrast the adjective draws.
senses.whyCN: 仪式性行动全是意义、少有后果，这正是这个形容词所划出的对比。

senses.title: Representing an abstract quantity
senses.definition: standing in for a variable or abstract entity in mathematics and formal systems
senses.definitionCN: 在数学与形式系统中代表变量或抽象对象
senses.example: In the proof, the letter is symbolic and can stand for any number.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个证明里，那个字母是符号性的，可以代表任何数。
senses.why: Algebra replaced particular numbers with letters, so a sign can now stand for a whole class of values.
senses.whyCN: 代数用字母取代了具体数字，因此一个标记现在可以代表一整类数值。

intro.en: Symbolic comes from Greek symbolikos, from symbolon, a token or sign, which passed through Latin symbolum and French symbolique into English.
intro.cn: symbolic 来自希腊 symbolikos，其词干 symbolon 指信物或标记，经拉丁 symbolum 与法语 symbolique 进入英语。

items.en: Symbolon named a token, often a half object matched with its other half to prove identity. It was built from a prefix meaning together and ballein, to throw, so the image is of things thrown together.
items.cn: symbolon 指信物，常为一件分成两半、以对合来证明身份的东西。它由表示「一起」的前缀与 ballein「投掷」构成，意象是把东西投到一起。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek word as symbolum, keeping the sense of a token, a creed or a sign by which something is recognized.
items.cn: 拉丁语借用该希腊词为 symbolum，保留「信物、信条、借以识别某物的标记」等义。

items.en: French formed the adjective symbolique, and English took it in the sixteenth century as symbolic, first in religious and then in general learned use.
items.cn: 法语造出形容词 symbolique，英语在十六世纪借入为 symbolic，先用于宗教，后进入一般学术用法。

items.en: Symbolism became the name of a literary and artistic movement, and symbolic gained the sense of suggesting inner states through visible forms.
items.cn: 象征主义成为一个文学与艺术运动的名称，symbolic 也获得「以可见形式暗示内心状态」的含义。

items.en: Logic and computing added the sense of working on formal expressions, giving phrases such as symbolic logic and symbolic computation.
items.cn: 逻辑学与计算机领域增添了「处理形式表达式」的含义，于是有符号逻辑、符号运算等说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin of the throwing root): the pre-Greek history of ballein is not established, and any older form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（「投掷」词根的更深来源）：ballein 在希腊语之前的历史未获证明，凡为其提出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds words from the sign family that look alike; group two holds adjectives for standing in place of something.
note.cn: 第一组是符号词族中形近的词；第二组是表示「代替某物」的形容词。

entries.definition: The mark or object that carries the meaning; symbolic is the adjective describing its relation to what it stands for.
entries.definitionCN: 承载意义的标记或物件；symbolic 是描述它与所指之物关系的形容词。

entries.definition: A system of symbols, or the artistic movement that uses them; it is a noun, not a description of one sign.
entries.definitionCN: 符号体系，或使用符号的艺术运动；它是名词，不是对单个标记的描述。

entries.definition: Indicating an underlying condition, from Greek piptein, to fall; the resemblance to symbolic is only in the shared prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 表明某种潜在状况，来自希腊语 piptein「落下」；与 symbolic 的相似只在共同前缀。

entries.definition: Balanced on two sides, from Greek metron, measure; it shares a prefix with symbolic but not a root.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧对称，来自希腊语 metron「尺度」；与 symbolic 共有前缀，却没有共同词根。

entries.definition: Serving as a visible emblem of a group or idea; it is close to symbolic but often suggests an official badge.
entries.definitionCN: 作为某个群体或观念的可见徽记；与 symbolic 相近，但常暗示正式的徽章。

entries.definition: Standing for a larger class because it is typical; symbolic standing comes from convention, not from being typical.
entries.definitionCN: 因具有典型性而代表更大的一类；象征性代表来自约定，而非典型性。

entries.definition: A small object or gesture that stands for something larger; token often stresses that the sign is minimal.
entries.definitionCN: 代表更大事物的小物件或姿态；token 常强调标记本身很小。

entries.definition: Existing as a name rather than a reality; this overlaps with the in-name-only sense of symbolic but lacks the sense of sign.
entries.definitionCN: 只作为名称而非现实存在；它与 symbolic 的「名义上」义重叠，但没有「符号」义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Greek token, the English sign family and the everyday gestures that mean more than they do.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：希腊信物、英语符号词族，以及那些意义大于实际作用的日常姿态。

normal.en: The Greek source is a token split in two, matched later to prove who is speaking.
normal.cn: 希腊语来源是一件分成两半的信物，日后对合以证明来者身份。

normal.en: The family runs symbol, symbolic, symbolically, symbolize, symbolism and symbolist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 symbol、symbolic、symbolically、symbolize、symbolism 与 symbolist。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the two halves: symbolic meaning and symbolic computation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出两端：象征意义与符号运算。

normal.en: A flag is the clearest example: cloth and dye, yet a whole group stands behind it.
normal.cn: 旗帜是最清楚的例子：只是布与染料，背后却站着一整个群体。

normal.en: The phrase with of points at what is represented: symbolic of a new beginning.
normal.cn: 与表示「关于」的词连用，指出被代表之物：象征新的开始。

abstract.en: Picture a door key handed over in a ceremony but never used on a lock.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙在仪式上被交出，却从未插进任何锁。

abstract.en: Picture a wedding ring worn on a hand that works all day.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚婚戒戴在一只整天劳作的手上。

abstract.en: Picture a blank signature line that everyone treats as a promise.
abstract.cn: 想象一条空白的签名线，所有人都把它当成承诺。

examples.en: The handshake was symbolic, but it ended a decade of dispute.
examples.cn: 那次握手是象征性的，却终结了十年的争端。

examples.en: In symbolic logic, letters replace statements rather than numbers.
examples.cn: 在符号逻辑中，字母替代的是陈述，而不是数字。

examples.en: The colour red is symbolic of luck in many local festivals.
examples.cn: 在许多地方节庆中，红色象征好运。

dict_mnemonic.note: 拆词联想 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 一件小东西替一件大事站出来，所有人都认这个替身 → 象征的、符号的

root: 希腊 symbolon「信物、标记」= 表示「一起」的前缀 + ballein「投掷」，形容词 symbolikos；经拉丁 symbolum、法语 symbolique 入英语为 symbolic。ballein 更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one relation: a visible sign stands for something absent, and the same relation is then found in codes, empty gestures, art, computation, public memory, ritual and algebra.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种关系展开：一个可见标记替不在场之物站出来，这种关系随后出现在代码、空姿态、艺术、运算、公共记忆、仪式与代数中。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flag on a pole holding the place of a whole crowd.
core.cn: 核心意象：旗杆上的一面旗，占着一整群人的位置。

branches.en: THE RELATION: the sign is present where the meaning is not.
branches.cn: 关系：标记在场，意义却不在场。

branches.en: THE CODE: a sign means only because a system gives it a place.
branches.cn: 代码：标记之所以有意义，只因系统给了它位置。

branches.en: THE EMPTY GESTURE: meaning without consequence, done for what it declares.
branches.cn: 空姿态：有意义而无后果，为所宣告之事而做。

branches.en: THE ART: visible forms are asked to carry inner states.
branches.cn: 艺术：可见形式被要求承载内心状态。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC AND FORMAL: shared memory and formal manipulation both work through accepted signs.
branches.cn: 公共与形式：共同记忆与形式操作都通过被接受的标记运作。

intro.en: Symbolic is a Greek noun turned adjective, and its family covers signs, the study of signs and the act of making one thing stand for another.
intro.cn: symbolic 是由希腊名词转成的形容词，其词族涵盖符号、符号研究以及使一物代表另一物的动作。

latinIntro.en: Latin symbolum and Late Latin symbolicus carry the Greek term; English then adds noun, verb and adverb forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 symbolum 与晚期拉丁 symbolicus 承载这个希腊词；英语随后加上名词、动词与副词形式。

items.meaning: a sign that stands for something
items.example: The ring is a symbol of the promise.
items.exampleCN: 这枚戒指是承诺的象征。

items.example: The gift was symbolic rather than useful.
items.exampleCN: 这份礼物是象征性的，而非实用的。

items.example: The key was symbolically handed over.

items.meaning: a system of symbols or an artistic movement
items.example: The poem is dense with symbolism.
The symbolist painted dreams, not scenes.
items.exampleCN: 这位象征派画家画的是梦，不是场景。

items.meaning: the act of representing by symbols
items.example: The symbolization of the river took centuries.
items.exampleCN: 这条河被符号化的过程历经数百年。

items.meaning: the study or use of symbols
items.example: The map's symbology is explained in the margin.
items.exampleCN: 地图符号的用法在页边有说明。

items.meaningCN: 缺乏象征意义或功能的
items.example: The test uses asymbolic shapes as controls.
items.exampleCN: 该测试用无象征意义的形状作为对照。

derivatives.meaning: in a way that stands for something else

definition_zh: 象征主义；象征手法；象征体系
definition_en: the use of symbols to suggest ideas and feelings, or a system of such symbols
core_image: 一只白鸽、一盏灯、一株枯树，各自不只是自己，而指向看不见的意思
scene: 诗人拒绝直说，用月亮、镜子和秋天暗示难以言明的情绪。The poet refused direct statement and used moons, mirrors and autumn, trusting symbolism to carry the feeling.
sceneCN: 这里指「用意象暗示言外之意的象征手法」（第 1 个义项：以象征表达观念）；句意为诗人拒绝直说，借月亮、镜子与秋天让象征手法承载情绪。可辨识物件：月亮、镜子、秋天的树、诗稿。

pos.zh: 象征主义（文学与艺术运动）

forms.label: 复数形式（指多种象征体系）

derivatives.zh: 象征主义者；象征派的（由基础词加表示「信奉者」的后缀构成，语义收窄为身份）
象征的；象征性的（由基础词加表示「与……有关的」后缀构成，语义偏移为性质描述）
象征性地（由前一个形容词加构成副词的后缀构成，语义偏移为方式）
象征学；符号体系（由基础词加表示学科的后缀构成，语义偏移为研究领域）

senses.title: Use of symbols to convey ideas
senses.titleCN: 用象征传达观念的手法
senses.definition: the practice of using one thing to stand for another idea or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 用一个事物代表另一个观念或感受的做法
senses.example: The poet trusted symbolism to carry the feeling.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人让象征手法承载情绪。
senses.why: The Greek word behind symbol meant a token split in two and matched later for recognition. One half stands for the whole, and that structure is the core of symbolism.
senses.whyCN: symbol 背后的希腊词指一分为二、日后拼合以确认身份的信物。一半代表整体，这一结构正是象征的核心。

senses.title: The Symbolist movement
senses.definition: the late nineteenth-century literary and artistic movement that favoured suggestion over description
senses.definitionCN: 十九世纪末偏爱暗示而非描写的文学与艺术运动
senses.example: Symbolism began as a revolt against realistic description.
senses.exampleCN: 象征主义最初是对写实描写的反叛。
senses.why: The movement took the general practice and made it a programme: never name the feeling, let the image carry it.
senses.whyCN: 这场运动把一般做法变成纲领：永远不要直接说出感受，让意象去承载。

senses.title: A system of symbols
senses.definition: an organised set of signs used by a religion, culture or institution
senses.definitionCN: 宗教、文化或机构使用的一整套有组织的符号
senses.example: Religious symbolism fills the nave.
senses.exampleCN: 宗教象征体系布满中殿。
senses.why: When many symbols are related and repeated, they form a grammar that members of a community can read.
senses.whyCN: 当许多符号相互关联并反复出现，它们就构成一套社群成员能读懂的语法。

senses.title: The symbolic meaning of an object
senses.definition: the meaning an object carries beyond its literal use
senses.definitionCN: 某物在字面用途之外承载的含义
senses.example: The ring's symbolism outlives its gold.
senses.exampleCN: 这枚戒指的象征意义比它的黄金活得更久。
senses.why: Any object can acquire a second meaning by repeated association, and that second meaning is what the word names here.
senses.whyCN: 任何物件都能通过反复关联获得第二层意义，这里命名的正是那层意义。

senses.title: Dream symbolism
senses.definition: the interpretation of dream images as standing for hidden wishes or fears
senses.definitionCN: 把梦中意象解释为隐藏愿望或恐惧的替身
senses.example: Dream symbolism gave the water a second meaning.
senses.exampleCN: 梦境象征让水有了第二层意义。
senses.why: Psychoanalysis treated dream images as a coded language, so the word entered medicine as a method of decoding.
senses.whyCN: 精神分析把梦中意象当作编码语言，因此这个词作为解码方法进入医学。

senses.title: Colour and number symbolism
senses.definition: fixed meanings attached to particular colours or numbers within a culture
senses.definitionCN: 某种文化中附着于特定颜色或数字的固定含义
senses.example: Colour symbolism makes white mean mourning in one place and joy in another.
senses.exampleCN: 颜色象征使白色在一地表示哀悼，在另一地表示喜悦。
senses.why: Colour and number are abstract, so cultures assign them meanings by convention, and the meanings travel with the group.
senses.whyCN: 颜色与数字本身抽象，文化便按约定给它们分配含义，而这些含义随群体流传。

senses.title: Political and national symbolism
senses.definition: flags, colours, monuments and rituals used to represent a state or cause
senses.definitionCN: 用来代表国家或事业的旗帜、颜色、纪念碑与仪式
senses.example: National symbolism gathered around the old bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 国族象征聚集在那座老桥周围。
senses.why: A political body needs visible signs that can be shared by strangers, so symbolism becomes a tool of unity and claim.
senses.whyCN: 政治体需要陌生人也能共享的可见符号，因此象征成为团结与主张的工具。

senses.title: Symbolic notation in logic
senses.titleCN: 逻辑与数学中的符号记法
senses.definition: the use of formal signs instead of words to make reasoning precise
senses.definitionCN: 用形式化符号代替词语、使推理精确的做法
senses.example: Modern logic depends on symbolism more than on prose.
senses.exampleCN: 现代逻辑依赖符号记法甚于散文。
senses.why: Here a symbol is not suggestive but exact. The same word covers both the poetic sign and the mathematical one, because both stand in place of something else.
senses.whyCN: 这里的符号不求暗示，而求精确。同一个词兼指诗性符号与数学符号，因为两者都代替别的东西。

intro.en: Symbolism comes from a Greek word for a token matched to its other half. Latin borrowed it, and the suffix for doctrines made it a movement. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: symbolism 来自一个希腊词，指可与另一半拼合以确认身份的信物。拉丁语借入该词，表示学说的后缀又把它变成一场运动。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek symballein meant 'to throw together', from syn- 'together' plus ballein 'to throw'. Its deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 希腊 symballein 意为「一起投掷」，由 syn-「一起」加 ballein「投掷」构成。其更深来源属「来源不确定」。

items.en: A symbolon was a token broken in two, each half kept by one party and matched later as proof of identity. The sign and the thing it stood for were two halves of one object.
items.cn: symbolon 是分成两半的信物，双方各持一半，日后拼合以证明身份。符号与它所代表之物，正是同一物件的两半。

items.en: Latin symbolum kept the senses of token, creed and sign, and from it English took symbol in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 拉丁 symbolum 保留「信物、信条、符号」诸义，英语在十五世纪由它借入 symbol。

items.en: The poet Jean Moréas published a manifesto of Symbolisme in 1886, and the label spread to painting and music.
items.cn: 诗人莫雷亚斯在一八八六年发表《象征主义》宣言，这个标签随后扩散到绘画与音乐。

items.en: English adopted symbolism for both the movement and the general practice of standing one thing for another.
items.cn: 英语用 symbolism 兼指这场运动与「以一物代表另一物」的一般做法。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Greek origin of ballein is unresolved, and any older root proposed for it is a reconstructed form rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定：ballein 在希腊语之前的来源没有定论，为其提出的更早词根属于重构形式，而非有记录的真实词形。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same word that are constantly confused; group two holds neighbouring ways of meaning something indirectly.
note.cn: 第一组是同一个词的不同形式，常被混淆；第二组是间接表意的相邻方式。

entries.definition: the thing that stands for something else; symbolism is the practice or system built from such things.
entries.definitionCN: 代表另一事物的东西；symbolism 是由这些符号构成的做法或体系。

entries.definition: acting as a sign of something else; it describes a single sign, while symbolism names a practice.
entries.definitionCN: 作为另一事物之标志的；它描述单个符号，而 symbolism 指做法。

entries.definition: an artist of the movement, or an adjective for its style; symbolism is the movement's name.
entries.definitionCN: 这场运动中的艺术家，或形容其风格的形容词；symbolism 是运动名称。

entries.definition: the study or system of symbols; it names research or a catalogue, not the artistic method.
entries.definitionCN: 对符号的研究或符号体系；它指研究或分类，而非艺术手法。

entries.definition: calling one thing another to transfer meaning; it is a figure of language, while symbolism can work without words.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物称作另一物以转移意义；它是语言修辞，而象征可以在没有语言的情况下运作。

entries.definition: a story whose characters and events each stand for a second meaning; it is more systematic and explicit than symbolism.
entries.definitionCN: 人物与事件各自代表第二层意义的故事；比象征更系统、更明确。

entries.definition: vivid sensory description in writing; imagery may or may not carry a symbolic second meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 写作中鲜明的感官描写；意象可以带有、也可以不带象征的第二层意义。

entries.definition: a fixed sign with an official or public meaning; it shares the Greek throwing root but uses a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 具有官方或公共含义的固定标志；它共享希腊语「投掷」词根，但前缀不同。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek token was split in two, so a symbol is literally half of a pair.
normal.cn: 希腊信物被分成两半，因此一个符号字面上就是一对中的一半。

normal.en: The verb behind it means 'throw together', which is why a symbol joins two things into one sign.
normal.cn: 其后的动词意为「一起投掷」，所以象征把两样东西合成一个符号。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark its fields: religious, colour, national, dream.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出它的领域：宗教的、颜色的、国族的、梦境的。

normal.en: A symbolist is the artist; symbolic is the adjective; symbolism is the practice.
normal.cn: symbolist 指艺术家；symbolic 是形容词；symbolism 是做法。

normal.en: Symbolism became a named movement in 1886 with a published manifesto.
normal.cn: 象征主义在一八八六年随一份宣言成为有名号的运动。

abstract.en: Picture a broken coin where each half proves the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚裂开的硬币，两半各自证明对方。

abstract.en: Picture a moon that is also a mother and also an ending.
abstract.cn: 想象一轮月亮，同时是母亲，也是结局。

abstract.en: Picture a flag that makes a stranger stand still without knowing why.
abstract.cn: 想象一面旗，让陌生人不知为何就站住。

examples.en: Symbolism in the play turns the closed door into a whole history.
examples.cn: 剧中的象征手法把一扇关着的门变成一整段历史。

examples.en: The church's symbolism is explained on a small card.
examples.cn: 教堂的象征体系印在一张小卡片上说明。

examples.en: The movement of symbolism influenced music and painting alike.
examples.cn: 象征主义运动同时影响了音乐与绘画。

dict_mnemonic.note: 谐音记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 「符号 + 主义」—— 用看得见的东西代表看不见的意思 → 象征主义、象征手法

root: 经拉丁 symbolum 上溯至希腊 symbolon「一分为二的认亲信物」，源自 symballein（syn-「一起」+ ballein「投掷」）；再加表示学说的后缀构成主义之名。ballein 更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one sign standing for another: poetic suggestion, a named movement, a religious grammar, a single object's second meaning, dreams, colour, the nation, and finally the exact notation of logic.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕「一物代表另一物」展开：诗性暗示、有名号的运动、宗教语法、单件物体的第二层意义、梦境、颜色、国族，最后是精确的逻辑记法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dove on a windowsill that is also, for the viewer, peace.
core.cn: 核心意象：窗台上的一只白鸽，在观者眼中同时是和平。

branches.en: THE BASIC MOVE: one thing is made to stand for another, and an object gains a second meaning.
branches.cn: 基本动作：一物被用来代表另一物，物体因此获得第二层意义。

branches.en: THE MOVEMENT: suggestion becomes a programme and a named school.
branches.cn: 运动：暗示变成纲领，也成为有名号的流派。

branches.en: THE GRAMMAR: religion and colour assign fixed signs that a community can read.
branches.cn: 语法：宗教与颜色分配固定符号，供社群共同读取。

branches.en: THE INNER AND THE PUBLIC: dreams decode private images, while nations display public ones.
branches.cn: 内在与公共：梦境解读私人意象，国族展示公共意象。

branches.en: THE EXACT EDGE: logic uses signs that are precise rather than suggestive.
branches.cn: 精确的边缘：逻辑使用精确而非暗示性的符号。

intro.en: Symbolism belongs to a Greek family built on throwing things together, which is why a symbol joins two halves into one sign.
intro.cn: symbolism 属于一个以「把东西投到一起」为核心的希腊词族，因此一个符号把两半合成一个记号。

latinIntro.en: Greek symbolon passed into Latin as symbolum, and English took symbol, symbolic and symbolism from that stem; emblem shares the throwing root with a different prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 symbolon 进入拉丁语作 symbolum，英语从这一词干取得 symbol、symbolic 与 symbolism；emblem 共享「投掷」词根，但前缀不同。

items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把两半合在一起。

items.example: Ballein is the root of symbol and emblem.
items.exampleCN: ballein 是 symbol 与 emblem 的词根。

items.meaning: a token thrown together; a matched half
items.meaningCN: 拼合的信物；配对的一半

items.exampleCN: 拉丁 symbolum 给出英语 symbol。

items.meaning: a sign standing for something else
items.example: The ring is a symbol of promise.

items.exampleCN: 这个姿态具有象征意义。

items.meaning: the practice or system of signs

items.exampleCN: 这位象征主义者避免直接点名。
象征学给这些符号编目。

items.meaning: a fixed sign with public meaning
items.meaningCN: 具有公共含义的固定标志
items.example: The eagle is an emblem of the state.

definition_zh: 对称；对称性；匀称；数学与物理中的不变性；对应一致
definition_en: the quality of having parts that correspond exactly on opposite sides of a line or plane, and the wider idea of balanced correspondence
core_image: 一张纸沿中线对折，两半严丝合缝地重合在一起
scene: 剪纸老师把一张纸对折，剪出的两侧完全重合，The students check the symmetry of the folded snowflake against a mirror.
sceneCN: 这里 symmetry 指「图形沿轴线两侧完全对应的性质」（第 1 个义项：镜像对称）；句意为学生把折好的雪花拿到镜子前，检查它是否对称。图中可辨识物件：对折的纸、剪刀、雪花形与镜子。

pos.zh: 对称；对称性；匀称；一致性

senses.title: Mirror correspondence across an axis
senses.titleCN: 沿轴线两侧的镜像对应
senses.definition: the property of a shape whose two halves match exactly when folded along a line
senses.definitionCN: 图形沿一条线对折时两半完全重合的性质
senses.example: The butterfly's wings show near-perfect symmetry.
senses.exampleCN: 蝴蝶的双翅呈现近乎完美的对称。
senses.why: Greek symmetria meant 'agreement in measure'; the most visible agreement is two halves matching across a line.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 symmetria 意为「度量上的一致」；最直观的一致，就是沿一条线的两半彼此吻合。

senses.title: Pleasing balance and proportion
senses.definition: an arrangement whose parts are well proportioned and visually balanced
senses.definitionCN: 各部分比例得当、视觉上均衡的布局
senses.example: The façade owes its calm to the symmetry of its windows.
senses.exampleCN: 这面立面之所以显得沉静，靠的是窗户的匀称排布。
senses.why: Agreement in measure applies to whole compositions, not only to mirrored halves, so proportion becomes a sense of its own.
senses.whyCN: 「度量上的一致」适用于整幅构图，而不只适用于镜像两半，比例感因此独立成义。

senses.title: Invariance under a transformation
senses.definition: in mathematics, the property of an object that looks the same after a specified transformation
senses.definitionCN: 数学中，物体经过某种指定变换后仍保持原样的性质
senses.example: A circle has rotational symmetry about its centre.
senses.exampleCN: 圆相对于圆心具有旋转对称性。
senses.why: Mathematics generalises folding into transformation: the object is unchanged when a move is applied, which is symmetry in the precise sense.
senses.whyCN: 数学把「对折」推广为「变换」：施以某种操作后对象不变，这就是精确意义上的对称。

senses.title: Ordered arrangement in a crystal
senses.definition: the regular repeating arrangement of atoms or faces in a crystal
senses.definitionCN: 晶体中原子或晶面规则重复的排布
senses.example: The mineral's external symmetry reflects its internal lattice.
senses.exampleCN: 这种矿物的外部对称反映了其内部晶格。
senses.why: Crystals repeat a unit in space, and that repetition is the three-dimensional version of a symmetric pattern.
senses.whyCN: 晶体在空间中重复一个单元，这种重复正是对称图案的三维版本。

senses.title: Balanced body plan in biology
senses.definition: the correspondence of body parts in an organism, as bilateral or radial symmetry
senses.definitionCN: 生物体各部位之间的对应，如两侧对称或辐射对称
senses.example: Radial symmetry lets a sea anemone meet the world from every side.
senses.exampleCN: 辐射对称让海葵能从各个方向面对外界。
senses.why: A body plan distributes organs around an axis, so the same geometric agreement becomes a biological category.
senses.whyCN: 体制把器官围绕一条轴分布，同样的几何一致性便成为生物分类范畴。

senses.title: Correspondence between two things
senses.titleCN: 两事物之间的对应一致
senses.definition: a satisfying match or balance between two sets of things
senses.definitionCN: 两组事物之间令人满意的匹配或平衡
senses.example: There is a neat symmetry between the two countries' histories.
senses.exampleCN: 两国的历史之间存在一种整齐的对应。
senses.why: The figurative step compares two sides of any contrast, not just two halves of a shape.
senses.whyCN: 这一步比喻把任何对照的两边相比较，而不只是图形的两半。

senses.title: A physical invariance and its conservation law
senses.titleCN: 物理不变性及其守恒律
senses.definition: in physics, an invariance of a system that corresponds to a conserved quantity
senses.definitionCN: 物理学中，系统的一种不变性，对应某个守恒量
senses.example: Time-translation symmetry underlies the conservation of energy.
senses.exampleCN: 时间平移对称是能量守恒的基础。
senses.why: If a system behaves the same after a shift in time, physics shows that a quantity must stay fixed, linking symmetry to conservation.
senses.whyCN: 若系统在时间平移后表现相同，物理学便证明某个量必须保持不变，从而把对称与守恒联系起来。

senses.title: Symmetry of a relation (logic)
senses.definition: the property of a relation that holds in both directions whenever it holds in one
senses.definitionCN: 一种关系只要单向成立、反向也必成立的性质
senses.example: The relation 'is a sibling of' is symmetric.
senses.exampleCN: 「是……的兄弟姐妹」这一关系是对称的。
senses.why: Logic abstracts the mirror idea into a rule about ordered pairs: swapping the two items changes nothing.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑把镜像观念抽象为关于有序对的规则：交换两项，关系不变。

intro.en: Symmetry comes from Greek symmetria 'agreement in dimensions, due proportion', built on syn- 'together' and metron 'measure', and passed into English through Latin. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: symmetry 来自希腊语 symmetria「尺寸一致、比例得当」，由 syn-「共同」与 metron「度量」构成，经拉丁语进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Metron meant 'measure, rule, proportion'. It is generally connected with a root meaning 'to measure', but the exact pre-Greek form is a reconstruction.
items.cn: metron 意为「度量、尺度、比例」。它一般认为与意为「测量」的词根相关，但其希腊语之前的确切形式属重构。

items.en: The prefix syn- meant 'together, with', and it still marks words that join two things into one arrangement.
items.cn: 前缀 syn- 意为「共同、一起」，至今仍标记把两件事合成一个安排的词。

items.en: Syn- plus metron produced symmetria, 'a measuring together', hence agreement in size and due proportion.
items.cn: syn- 加 metron 构成 symmetria，即「一起度量」，引申为尺寸一致与比例得当。

items.en: Latin symmetria carried the word into sixteenth-century English, where it first described proportion in buildings and bodies.
items.cn: 拉丁 symmetria 把这个词带入 16 世纪的英语，最初描述建筑与人体中的比例。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geometry and group theory gave symmetry its precise sense of invariance under a transformation.
items.cn: 19 世纪的几何学与群论赋予 symmetry「变换下不变」的精确含义。

items.en: Source uncertain (first record and deeper root): the date of the English borrowing is approximate, and the pre-Greek origin of metron is not established, so proposed roots are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：英语借入的年代只是约数，metron 在希腊语之前的来源亦无定论，所提词根属重构形式。

note.en: The first group holds forms of the same Greek word beside a look-alike from another root; the second holds ideas of balance that are not the same relation.
note.cn: 第一组是同根词形与一个异根形近词并列；第二组是相关的平衡概念，但并非同一种关系。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning having symmetry; it is the same root with an adjective ending.
entries.definitionCN: 表示具有对称性的形容词；同根加形容词词尾。

entries.definition: The shorter technical adjective, common in mathematics and physics.
entries.definitionCN: 较短的技术形容词，常用于数学与物理。

entries.definition: Compassionate or showing agreement; it joins syn- to pathos 'feeling', not to metron 'measure'.
entries.definitionCN: 有同情心的或表示赞同的；由 syn- 加 pathos「感受」构成，与 metron「度量」无关。

entries.definition: An even distribution of weight or parts; it can exist without exact mirror correspondence.
entries.definitionCN: 重量或部分的均匀分布；不必有精确的镜像对应。

entries.definition: The relation of parts to one another in size; symmetry is one way of achieving pleasing proportion.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分在大小上的相互关系；对称是获得悦目比例的一种方式。

entries.definition: A pleasing combination of elements; it is broader and less geometric than symmetry.
entries.definitionCN: 元素之间悦目的组合；比 symmetry 更宽泛，也更少几何意味。

entries.definition: The absence of mirror correspondence, often deliberate in art and design.
entries.definitionCN: 缺乏镜像对应，在艺术与设计中常是有意为之。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two Greek pieces, the everyday image of folding, and the technical extensions.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个希腊构件、对折的日常形象，以及技术领域的延伸。

normal.en: Syn- 'together' plus metron 'measure' = the same measure on both sides.
normal.cn: syn-「共同」+ metron「度量」= 两侧度量相同。

normal.en: Fold the paper and the two halves land on each other: that is symmetry you can feel.
normal.cn: 把纸对折，两半彼此落在对方身上：这是能摸到的对称。

normal.en: A circle turns and looks unchanged, which is rotational symmetry.
normal.cn: 圆转一圈仍看不出变化，这就是旋转对称。

normal.en: A snowflake repeats its arms around a centre, the crystal version of the same idea.
normal.cn: 雪花六臂绕中心重复，是同一观念在晶体中的版本。

normal.en: In physics, a symmetry that survives a shift forces some quantity to be conserved.
normal.cn: 在物理学中，经某种平移仍保持的对称会迫使某个量守恒。

abstract.en: Picture a conversation in which both speakers answer with exactly the same structure.
abstract.cn: 想象一场对话，双方用完全相同的结构回应。

abstract.en: Picture a doorway that looks the same whether you enter or leave.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，无论进出看起来都一样。

abstract.en: Picture a rule that treats the two sides of a relation as interchangeable.
abstract.cn: 想象一条把关系两侧视为可互换的规则。

examples.en: The architect used symmetry to make the entrance feel stable.
examples.cn: 建筑师用对称让入口显得稳定。

examples.en: The equation has a symmetry that predicts a conserved charge.
examples.cn: 这个方程具有一种对称性，可预言某个守恒荷。

examples.en: Critics noticed the symmetry between the novel's first and last chapters.
examples.cn: 评论家注意到这部小说首章与末章之间的对应。

dict_mnemonic.note: 谐音记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 「symmetry」听成「四面吹里」——四面吹来的风都一个样，左右前后彼此对应，就是对称。syn 是一起，metron 是度量，两边量得一样便成对称。

root: 希腊语 syn-「共同」加 metron「度量」构成 symmetria「一起度量、尺寸一致、比例得当」，经拉丁 symmetria 进入英语，先指建筑与人体的比例，后由数学赋予「变换下不变」的精确义。metron 的更早来源属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start with mirror correspondence, then widen to proportion, mathematical invariance, crystals, body plans, correspondence between things, physical conservation and logical relations.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从镜像对应开始，依次扩展到比例匀称、数学不变性、晶体排布、生物体制、事物间对应、物理守恒与逻辑关系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet folded along a line so that one half lands exactly on the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸沿一条线对折，一半恰好落在另一半上。

branches.en: THE MIRROR TEST: the core sense is exact correspondence across a line or plane.
branches.cn: 镜像检验：核心义是沿一条线或一个面的精确对应。

branches.en: MEASURE AND TRANSFORMATION: pleasing proportion and mathematical invariance both keep parts in a fixed relation.
branches.cn: 度量与变换：悦目的比例与数学不变性都把各部分维持在固定关系中。

branches.en: REPEAT IN SPACE: crystals repeat a unit in three dimensions, and organisms distribute parts around a body axis.
branches.cn: 空间重复：晶体在三维中重复单元，生物则把各部位围绕体轴分布。

branches.en: BALANCE ACROSS DOMAINS: two histories can mirror each other, and a physical shift can leave a law unchanged.
branches.cn: 跨领域的平衡：两段历史可以互相映照，物理平移也可以让定律保持不变。

branches.en: ABSTRACT RULE: logic reduces mirroring to a statement about swapping the two sides of a relation.
branches.cn: 抽象规则：逻辑把镜像化为关于交换关系两侧的陈述。

intro.en: Symmetry is a Greek compound with a productive English family, so its pieces and derived words can be read separately.
intro.cn: symmetry 是希腊语复合词，英语词族活跃，其构件与派生词可以分开读出。

latinIntro.en: Greek syn- and metron build symmetria, which Latin borrowed unchanged in meaning; English added -ic, -ical and the negative prefix a-.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 syn- 与 metron 构成 symmetria，拉丁借入时保留原义；英语再加两个形容词词尾与否定前缀 a-。

items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把两个观念合成一个安排。

items.example: The root supplies the measuring half of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供词中「度量」那一半。

items.example: The Greek noun already contained both the mirror and the proportional ideas.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊名词已同时含有镜像与比例两种观念。

items.exampleCN: 这个后缀见于「几何学」与「三角学」等词。

items.example: English widened the noun from proportion to transformation.
items.exampleCN: 英语把这个名词从比例扩展到变换。

items.example: The suffix gives the technical adjective symmetric.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成技术形容词「对称的」。

items.example: The negative prefix builds the opposite term asymmetry.

definition_en: showing that you understand and care about someone else s trouble
core_image: 朋友低声听着，眉头跟着对方一起皱起
scene: 听完她的遭遇，朋友们都很同情。Her friends were sympathetic when they heard her story.
sceneCN: 这里 sympathetic 是「同情的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：听完她的遭遇，朋友们都很同情。

senses.title: Feeling for someone in trouble
senses.definition: showing care about another person s suffering
senses.definitionCN: 对他人的痛苦表示关心
senses.example: Her friends were sympathetic when they heard her story.
senses.exampleCN: 听完她的遭遇，朋友们都很同情。
senses.why: The Greek root means sharing feeling, so the adjective names feeling alongside another.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为共同感受，因此这个形容词指与他人一同感受。

senses.title: Favourable to an idea
senses.definition: willing to support a plan or view
senses.definitionCN: 愿意支持某个计划或观点
senses.example: The committee was sympathetic to the proposal.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会赞同这项提议。
senses.why: Sharing another person s feeling extends to sharing their view.
senses.whyCN: 与他人共感会延伸到认同他们的看法。

senses.title: Kind and considerate
senses.definition: gentle in the way you treat others
senses.definitionCN: 待人温和周到
senses.example: The nurse gave a sympathetic smile.
senses.exampleCN: 护士体贴地笑了笑。
senses.why: A person who feels with you will usually act gently, so the word also means considerate.
senses.whyCN: 能与你共感的人通常会温和行事，于是这个词也表示体贴。

items.cn: sympatheia 意为共同的感受。

items.en: Pathos meant what is felt or suffered.
items.cn: pathos 意为所感或所受。

items.en: Late Latin sympathia named shared feeling.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 sympathia 指共同的感受。

items.en: Sympathetic first described natural harmony between things.
items.cn: sympathetic 最初描述事物之间的天然共鸣。

items.en: Sympathetic narrowed to caring about another s trouble.
items.cn: sympathetic 收窄为关心他人疾苦。

note.en: Sympathetic is compared with look-alike words and with words for caring.

abstract.cn: 同情就是把自己的心暂时借给别人。

abstract.en: Sympathy costs nothing and changes everything.

abstract.en: The sympathetic person stands beside, not above.

definition_en: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is suffering
core_image: 一束白花放在门口，卡片上只写着一句节哀
scene: 她对他的失去深表同情。She felt great sympathy for his loss.
sceneCN: 这里 sympathy 是「同情」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她对他的失去深表同情。

senses.title: Feeling sorry for another
senses.definition: the feeling of pity for someone in trouble
senses.definitionCN: 对困境中人的怜惜之情
senses.example: She felt great sympathy for his loss.
senses.exampleCN: 她对他的失去深表同情。
senses.why: The Greek source means shared feeling, so the noun names the emotion felt alongside another.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语源头意为共同的感受，因此这个名词指与他人一同产生的情绪。

senses.title: The ability to feel for others
senses.definition: the capacity to understand another s suffering
senses.definitionCN: 理解他人痛苦的能力
senses.example: He has no sympathy for lazy excuses.
senses.exampleCN: 他对懒惰的借口毫无同情心。
senses.why: A single feeling became a lasting quality of character.
senses.whyCN: 一次的感受变成持久的品格。

senses.title: An expression of comfort
senses.definition: words or gifts offering comfort
senses.definitionCN: 表示安慰的话语或礼物
senses.example: They sent a letter of sympathy to the family.
senses.exampleCN: 他们给那家人寄去慰问信。
senses.why: Feeling must be expressed, so the noun also names the message that carries it.
senses.whyCN: 感受需要表达，因此这个名词也指承载它的讯息。

senses.title: Agreement with a cause
senses.definition: support for an idea or group
senses.definitionCN: 对某个主张或群体的支持
senses.example: The workers acted in sympathy with the strike.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们声援这场罢工。
senses.why: Sharing feeling slides into sharing a purpose, which yields the sense of support.
senses.whyCN: 共感滑向共同的目标，于是产生支持之义。

items.en: Sympathy settled on pity for another s trouble.
items.cn: sympathy 最终落定为对他人困苦的怜惜。

note.en: Sympathy is compared with look-alike words and with words for pity.
note.cn: 把 sympathy 与形近词以及表示怜悯的词作比较。

entries.definition: the ability to feel another s emotion

normalIntro.en: Sympathy is the feeling you hold when someone else is hurt.
normalIntro.cn: sympathy 是他人受伤时你心里生出的感受。

normal.en: She felt great sympathy for his loss.
normal.cn: 她对他的失去深表同情。

normal.en: They sent a letter of sympathy to the family.
normal.cn: 他们给那家人寄去慰问信。

normal.en: He has no sympathy for lazy excuses.
normal.cn: 他对懒惰的借口毫无同情心。

normal.en: The workers acted in sympathy with the strike.
normal.cn: 工人们声援这场罢工。

normal.en: Her sympathy was plain in her eyes.
normal.cn: 她的同情明明白白写在眼里。

abstract.en: Sympathy is the heart s way of standing next to someone.
abstract.cn: 同情是心站到别人身旁的方式。

abstract.en: Pity looks down, sympathy sits down.
abstract.cn: 怜悯俯视，同情坐下。

abstract.en: Sympathy given freely returns as courage.
abstract.cn: 自由给出的同情会以勇气归来。

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · sym-（共同）+ pathy（感受）
dict_mnemonic.text: sym- 表示共同，-pathy 表示感受；sympathy 即「共同感受」，是同情，也可指慰问与赞同。

root: 来自希腊语 sympatheia，由 syn（共同）与 pathos（感受）构成，经拉丁语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Sympathy is pity for another, the capacity to feel it, a message of comfort, or support for a cause.
sensesIntro.cn: sympathy 指对他人的怜惜、这种能力、慰问的讯息，或对某项事业的支持。

core.en: A feeling that crosses the space between two people.
core.cn: 一种越过两人之间距离的感受。

intro.en: Sympathy forms sympathies and the family sympathetic, sympathize and sympathizer.
intro.cn: sympathy 可构成复数 sympathies 以及 sympathetic、sympathize、sympathizer。

latinIntro.en: Sympathy is Greek; Latin compassio, suffering with, gives compassion.
latinIntro.cn: sympathy 源自希腊语；拉丁语 compassio（一同承受）衍生出 compassion。
